verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe a Keychain vault where credentials/keys can be stored once and referenced by multiple Hosts and Groups without duplication, with Personal and Team vaults synced and encrypted across devices. This directly matches the story of storing credentials once and reusing across hosts, though community corroboration is limited and some skepticism exists about storing secrets in a third-party app. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the vault reuse workflow and more detail on encryption implementation.
